'''Rod Latham Endor Drain''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls130.htm Endor Drain], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010426030716/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls130.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
